# Atlas of India
> Interactive historical atlas of India: 19 eras (500 BCE to today), approximate boundaries, events, journeys, person chronicles, place tracing. English and Hindi.

- Data: js/data.js (eras, places, events), js/geo.js (generated boundaries), js/routes.js (journeys), js/people.js (person chronicles), js/rivers.js
- Browser API: window.atlasAPI (see docs/API.md); iframe control via postMessage; embed with ?embed=1
- MCP server: node scripts/mcp_server.js (tools: list_eras, get_era, search, trace_place, list_people, get_person, compare_people)
- GeoJSON export: node scripts/export_geojson.js -> geojson/ ; data export: node scripts/export_data.js -> data/atlas.json
- Python CLI: python skills/atlas_cli.py (eras, era, search, trace, person, render)
- Static topic pages: topics/ (English + Hindi), sitemap.xml, built by node scripts/build_topics.js
- Boundaries are approximate and illustrative only. Present-day India follows India's official position (Natural Earth, India point of view). Data derived from aourednik/historical-basemaps (GPL-3.0).
